name: Ixmucané GeoPower

hero.eyebrow: Reservoir Engineering · AI Exploration · High-Performance Computing
hero.lead: Ixmucané GeoPower covers the full geothermal development lifecycle — from AI-driven regional favorability screening across Latin America, through geologic modelling, well targeting and design, to reservoir simulation, well testing and downhole logging.

stats.v: Parallel ensemble runs on NeSI, AWS and Azure high-performance computing infrastructure
Coupled mass, momentum & energy balance in porous and fractured media
Ensemble history-matching and probabilistic P10–P90 forecasts
